description: Angular component for configuring map marker settings within the Thingsboard platform, including form controls, validation, and dynamic UI updates based on user input.

classes.name: MarkersSettingsComponent
classes.description: Angular component for managing marker settings in map widgets, including form initialization, validation, and change propagation.

methods.name: ngOnInit
methods.description: Initializes the form group and sets up value change subscriptions for dynamic validation.

methods.name: ngOnChanges
methods.description: Handles changes to input properties, particularly 'provider', to update validators accordingly.

methods.name: registerOnChange
methods.description: Registers a callback function to propagate form value changes.

methods.name: registerOnTouched
methods.description: Placeholder for registering touch callback (not implemented).

methods.name: setDisabledState
methods.description: Enables or disables the form controls based on component's disabled state.

methods.name: writeValue
methods.description: Patches form controls with provided marker settings value.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the form group, returning validation errors if invalid.

methods.name: updateModel
methods.description: Updates internal model and propagates changes to parent form.

methods.name: updateValidators
methods.description: Dynamically enables/disables form controls based on current form state and provider type.
